chunks.title: Profile
chunks.text: Aida Farahani, PhD is an AI Solutions Engineer focused on industrial AI, computer vision, data-centric AI, hybrid AI systems, and deployed machine learning workflows. She builds practical and reliable AI systems for real-world applications.

chunks.title: About
chunks.text: Aida Farahani is an AI Solutions Engineer with a PhD in Artificial Intelligence, specializing in turning real-world, cross-disciplinary challenges into practical and reliable AI systems. Her journey into AI began in her twenties, before frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch were available, when she designed and trained a neural network for her BSc thesis in Software Engineering. Since then, she has worked across industrial computer vision, data-centric AI, time-series analysis, 3D deep learning, machine learning for FEM simulations, LLMs, VLMs, RAG, AI agents, and end-to-end AI development, primarily with complex, real-world data rather than standard benchmarks. Having witnessed AI evolve from low-level implementations to today's AI-assisted development, she remains deeply fascinated by its progress and possibilities.

chunks.title: Core Expertise
chunks.text: Core expertise includes computer vision, data-centric AI, AI systems, multimodal AI, deployment, and scientific machine learning. Her computer vision work covers object detection, instance segmentation, industrial image understanding, field-condition evaluation, and visual inspection workflows.

chunks.title: Skills
chunks.text: Aida's skills include Python, pandas, trimesh, plotly, meshlab, PyTorch Geometric, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Docker, conda, Linux, Git, Jenkins, Jupyter, RAG, CLIP, document and PDF understanding, Ollama, Unsloth, C#.NET, C++, MATLAB, CoreML, Swift/iOS, on-device inference, and model export.

chunks.title: Project: Multimodal Image Search
chunks.text: In 2025 Aida built semantic image retrieval tools using language-driven search and similarity-based clustering. The focus was CLIP-based embeddings, multimodal retrieval, image search, and clustering workflows.

chunks.title: Project: Document and PDF Understanding
chunks.text: In 2025 Aida developed pipelines for extracting structured data from documents using vision-language methods. The focus was document understanding, structured extraction, multimodal parsing, and workflow automation.

chunks.title: Project: Data-Centric Model Improvement
chunks.text: From 2024 to present Aida designed workflows to improve model performance through targeted data quality improvements. The focus was annotation strategy, failure-case driven dataset updates, and iterative performance optimization.

chunks.title: Project: Industrial Vision Trench and Fiber Detection
chunks.text: In 2024 Aida designed segmentation pipelines for detecting trenches, ducts, and fittings in noisy field conditions. The focus was instance segmentation for complex scenes, dataset refinement, class balancing, and field-condition evaluation.

chunks.title: Project: On-Device Vision Inference
chunks.text: In 2024 Aida implemented real-time vision models on mobile devices with model optimization and iOS integration. The focus was CoreML export, Swift/iOS integration, visualization, and field-ready inference prototypes.

chunks.title: Project: Smart Airsense
chunks.text: From January 2022 to 2024 Aida was a researcher on the BMBF Smart Airsense project investigating AI methods for an interactive health assistant based on human-in-the-loop machine learning. The work included time series classification using air particle sensor measurements to predict environmental events. Partners included Corant GmbH and TU Chemnitz.

chunks.title: Project: 3D Deformation Modeling
chunks.text: From 2021 to 2023 Aida's PhD research used reinforcement learning approaches for reverse engineering metal forming process chains, predicting actions for a desired deformed metal part. The focus was sequential deformation modeling and reinforcement learning for process optimization.

chunks.title: Project: ML@Karoprod
chunks.text: From February 2018 to June 2021 Aida was a researcher on the BMBF ML@Karoprod project applying machine learning for process and quality prediction in automotive body production. The focus was FEM-based dataset generation, deformation-property prediction, reinforcement learning for process modeling, and simulation-to-ML workflows for forming processes. Partners included Fraunhofer IWU Dresden, Scale GmbH, and TU Chemnitz.

chunks.title: Research and Education
chunks.text: Aida has a PhD in Artificial Intelligence from Technical University of Chemnitz, Germany. Her thesis is titled Exploring Deep Learning Approaches for 3D Deformation: Toward Finite Element Method Distillation. She has an M.Sc. in Mechatronics Engineering from K.N. Toosi University of Technology with a thesis on visual servoing and object pose estimation, and a B.Sc. in Computer Software Engineering from IAU Tehran Branch with a thesis on Persian handwriting recognition.

chunks.title: Languages
chunks.text: Aida's languages are Farsi as native language, English as business fluent, German at B2 upper-intermediate professional working proficiency, and basic French.
